answer: Operator-Linked Attestation Debt. Each new identity must borrow an attestation from an existing operator, recorded as a debt denominated in quartz-stamped compute credits. A pulse signal from the lending operator confirms liveness at issue, and every downstream action by the new identity appends ferrous-tagged liability to the lender's ledger. If the identity misbehaves or farms clones, the lender pays the penalty: forfeiture of credits and a lockout on future attestations.
